Simulate genotypes with local LD

Source: R/simulate.R
simulate_geno.Rd

Dosages (0/1/2) from a Gaussian copula with AR(1) correlation between neighbouring SNPs and uniform minor-allele frequencies.

Usage

simulate_geno(n = 400, m = 250, rho = 0.6, maf = c(0.05, 0.5), seed = 1)

Arguments

n

Number of donors.

m

Number of SNPs.

rho

Correlation of adjacent SNPs.

maf

Range of minor-allele frequencies.

seed

Random seed.

Value

Integer matrix with donor IDs `D001...` and SNP IDs `SNP001...`.
